name: battleship
short: Hacking-themed Battleship with Elo, economy, and betting.
description: A hacking-themed Battleship game cog. Players place servers on a grid and launch exploits to sink opponents. Supports PvP and PvE (random AI). Includes real Elo ratings, win/loss leaderboard, economy rewards, and optional betting via Red's built-in bank.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores Discord User IDs to track game statistics (wins, losses, Elo rating). Data can be deleted upon user request.
